title: デビュー戦の後に・狼煙を上げろ

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Phew.
choice_data_list: That was great, Taishin! You must be tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not even. Hell, this isn't the time to be tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go.
Her cool demeanor never wavers, but I can tell her stride is much more confident than it was before the race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So about my next race…
choice_data_list: You're thinking about the next race already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You got a problem with that, or are you looking to get kicked again?
I'm still stinging from the one she gave me before the race, and I shake my head hurriedly.
If she were serious, I'm sure she could've put me in the hospital, so I assume she must've been holding back…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, about my next race… Or well, I guess this is more about my future plans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I want to take on the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna show up all my haters, I can't do just any old race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My only option is to win the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho, where only the best gather to battle it out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll win 'em and make everyone eat their words.
However, the Satsuki Sho is still a ways off. It would be best to enter her into some junior races so she can gain more experience.
To that end…
choice_data_list: How do you feel about running the Hopeful Stakes first?
How do you feel about running the Hopeful Stakes first?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Isn't that a junior G1 race?
Just like the Satsuki Sho, the Hopeful Stakes is a 2,000-meter race held at Nakayama Racecourse.
I tell her that it would be a good opportunity to get a feel for what the real deal will be like.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Got it. Then let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And if I'm running it, then I'm winning it.
With that, we set our sights on the Hopeful Stakes!
